meta.name: Warehouse pick and pack
meta.description: Orders arrive every minute on average (exponential), 60 an hour, day and night. They are gathered onto carts of 5 orders (a batch), and a picker takes each cart round the shelves in 9 min on average (exponential). The pickers work in shifts that repeat every day: 1 from 22:00 to 06:00 and 3 from 06:00 to 22:00. A full cart is wheeled to packing in exactly 3 min (a delay) and unloaded (an unbatch); each order is packed in 30 s on average (exponential) and dispatched. Theory: an order waits (5 - 1)/(2 x 1 per min) = 2 min for its cart to fill; the pickers are on shift 56 of 72 picker-hours a day, 7/9; no block loses an order, so 60 an hour are dispatched and the packer is busy 0.5 of the time. The run is 216 h long including 24 h of warm-up, so 192 h are measured: 8 whole days, sampled every hour.
